headline: Council approved $2,380,250 donation for First Light Commons and $383,262 UNE subaward for Nourish ME Rural Health Program
summary: The Council appointed William Ray and Justin Amen to city positions, approved a statement of no objection for the DiMillo's Old Port Marina project, and accepted donations for First Light Commons and the Police Department. It also passed amendments to City Code Chapter 4 on event licenses and heard first readings on a police donation and the National Electric Code.
decisions: Appointed William Ray as a Class B Director of the Portland Fish Pier Authority Board, passed 8-0.
Appointed Justin Amen as Constable for the Parking Division, passed 8-0.
Approved, as amended, authorizing the Mayor to execute a Statement of No Objection to the DiMillo's Old Port Marina Improvement Project, passed 8-0.
Amended Order 11-26/27 from the floor, passed 8-0.
Accepted and appropriated a $2,380,250 donation from the Portland Parks Conservancy for the construction of First Light Commons, passed as an emergency 8-0.
Waived second read for Order 12-26/27, passed 8-0.

Approved the Subaward Agreement between the University of New England and the City of Portland, accepting and appropriating $383,262 for the Nourish ME Rural Health Program, passed as an emergency 8-0.
Waived second read for Order 13-26/27, passed 8-0.
Approved Order 15-26/27, an amendment to Portland City Code Chapter 4 regarding event licenses, passed as an emergency 8-0.
Waived second read for Order 15-26/27, passed 8-0.
